'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jared LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jared]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
